hooks.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -e '.tool_input | tostring | contains(".env.local")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":".env.local access is blocked by project policy."}}' || true
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) black -q "$f" ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true
